identity.name: JBMR Plus
identity.source_note: Encoded from a Wayback archive snapshot of the Instructions to Authors (general-instructions) page: https://web.archive.org/web/20250907021856/https://academic.oup.com/jbmrplus/pages/general-instructions (captured 2025-09-07, within 12 months). The live page is reachable via plain fetch but truncates before the 'Manuscript Preparation Instructions' section; Apify headless render is 403-blocked by OUP's Cloudflare. Publisher, submission system, single-anonymized review, ORCID, article types, ISSN, and abstract cap were cross-checked against the live general-instructions page and matched.

encoding_notes: Publisher: JBMR Plus is the open-access ASBMR journal, companion to JBMR, published by Oxford University Press (academic.oup.com/jbmrplus). No migration. Submission via ScholarOne (mc.manuscriptcentral.com/jbmrplus).

Source: live general-instructions page is truncated by plain fetch before the manuscript-prep section, and OUP Cloudflare 403-blocks the Apify headless render; encoded instead from the 2025-09-07 Wayback snapshot of that same page (within the 12-month window). Values below are direct quotes from that snapshot.

Peer review is single-anonymized ('the identity of the authors is known to the editors and to the reviewers'), so double_blind=false and no blinding/title-page scrub is required. A title page IS required but as part of the manuscript, not for anonymization.

references.style='ama' is EXPLICIT ('JBMR Plus follows AMA style'). in_text='superscript', order='cited', journal_abbrev='nlm' are AMA-11th norms encoded as formatter targets, NOT independently quoted by the guide. Desk-reject risk is low because the guide states 'Authors may format references in any readable style at submission' and reformatting only occurs for the accepted version. include_doi=false set conservatively (guide silent).
et_al_threshold and references.max_count left null (guide states neither; per-type reference maxes live in word_limits).

Article-type mapping: Research Article->original_research (6000w; meta-analyses are welcomed under Research Article per the guide); Review->review (6000w, invited/unsolicited both accepted); Case Report->case_report (3000w); Methods and Techniques->technical_note (3000w); Letter to the Editor->letter (1000w); Editorial->editorial (1000w, invited). OMITTED with no clean schema slot (noted): Short Report (1000w brief study), Clinical Trial (3000w; duplicates original_research), Perspective (invited opinion), Task Force (invited ASBMR report), Registered Reports (1000w), Commentary (1000w, invited). No dedicated Systematic Review / Narrative Review type exists.

references_max by type: Case Report=20, Methods&Techniques=50 (EXPLICIT). Research Article, Review, Letter, Editorial list NO reference maximum -> references_max=null for those. references_min unstated for every type -> null.

figures_max/tables_max are stated as separate caps and map cleanly: original_research 6/6, review 6/6, case_report 5/2, technical_note 6/6. Letter/Editorial 'may include tables and figures in special circumstances' (contact editorial office) -> both null. (Omitted Short Report used a COMBINED cap of 2 figures-or-tables that the split schema can't hold.)

Abstract: 'unstructured, self-explanatory, have a maximum length of 300 words, and must not contain reference citations or abbreviations' -> structured=false, sections=null, max_words=300. Letters and Editorials have no abstract (abstract_max_words=null).
Keywords: 'maximum of 10 and minimum of 5' for research/review/case/methods types (Letter and Editorial cap at 10 with no stated minimum). Encoded min=5, max=10; case and separator unstated -> null.

SCHEMA GAP — Lay summary: every article type requires a Lay summary (max 100 words) placed after the abstract and keywords; a graphical abstract and video abstract are encouraged for all types. No schema field exists; not encoded. highlights_required=false (there is no 'Highlights' feature).

SCHEMA GAP — tiered figure DPI: color half-tones 300dpi, grayscale half-tones 600dpi, combination/line art 600-900dpi, monochrome line art 1200dpi; raster originals 300dpi minimum, TIFF preferred. min_dpi encodes the 300 floor only.

Figure formats: guide also lists .svg (with .eps/.pdf as the vector options), which is not in the schema's allowed format enum, so .svg was omitted from formats[]. Figure files 'named to match their citation (e.g., fig1.tiff, fig2.eps)' -> naming_pattern='fig{n}'. In-text callout wording (Figure vs Fig.) not stated -> callout_style=null.

figures.legends_location='figure_legends_section' encodes the guide's rule that 'Authors must include figure titles, legends, and captions within the manuscript file' (legends live in the manuscript, not as separate files); the guide does not prescribe inline vs. a dedicated legends section, so this is the closest available value.

Tables: 'Place all tables at the end of the main text' -> grouped_end; 'numbered consecutively ... table 1, table 2' -> arabic; supplied in editable format (Word), not as images. Caption/title position (above vs below) not stated -> null.

Title page (in order): title; author names + major degrees + affiliations; one corresponding-author email + mailing address; then disclosures (data availability, funding, conflict of interest, ethics approval if applicable, patient consent if applicable, permission to reproduce if applicable, clinical trial registration if applicable). authors_degrees='include' ('Author names, major degrees, and affiliations'). No running title is required (running_title_max_chars=null). title_max_words=15 is a soft target ('aim for no more than 15 words'); the '1-2 keywords within the first 65 characters' guidance is SEO advice, not a hard title character cap, so title_max_chars=null.

Declarations: data availability, funding, and conflict of interest are unconditionally required (title-page disclosures + 'data availability statement is a requirement' + 'requires all authors to disclose any potential conflict of interest'). Ethics approval, patient consent, and clinical trial registration are 'if applicable'. Acknowledgments is a required end-of-manuscript subheading when support exists (listed in order but not in required, since it is contingent). Author contributions are collected via CRediT at submission (system field), not written as a manuscript statement, so author_contributions is not encoded in declarations.

misc: orcid_required=true ('Submitting authors are required to provide an ORCID iD at submission'; co-authors encouraged). cover_letter_required=true (a Cover letter with required contents is specified under Manuscript Preparation). title_case unstated -> null.

Layout entirely unspecified: the guide prescribes no page size, font, line spacing, margins, alignment, indent, line numbers, page numbers, or running head (US spelling and AMA style are the only house-style rules). line_numbers set to 'none' (schema has no null option). Word counts exclude title page, abstract, tables, acknowledgments, references, and figure captions.
2026-07-18 doctrine audit: line_numbers 'none' was a default, not a guide statement — nulled so the engine preserves the author's setting.
